messages:
alice_vendor_ops: RelayLog flagged a support alert they found our webhook credential in plaintext in a restored archive. It was publicly readable for ~2h while they restored objects. Theyre patched the ACLs and uploaded an attestation. Need fast triage. :rotating_light:

ben_sre: Ack. Which credential? global integrations webhook or per-customer keys?

alice_vendor_ops: Looks like the global token `integrations-webhook-global`. Vendor sent redacted payloads + request IDs. They say the restore window was 2026-05-02T02:10:00Z to 2026-05-02T04:14:00Z.

carla_security: P1. Immediate playbook: rotate the token, revoke it, search for any use, get vendor purge evidence and signed attestation. Assign owners now.

dave_infra: I'll take rotation. Plan: generate new token, KMS-wrap, put in Secrets Manager (or Vault), canary deploy to integration workers, revoke old token. Will keep TTL short until audit complete.

alice_vendor_ops: Uploading the vendor attestation and object deletion log to the incident ticket shortly. RelayLog also offered to rotate any of their stored customer tokens on request. Link: https://relaylog.status/attest/REL-554

ben_sre: Starting quick scans across gateways, API proxies, CloudTrail/GCP audit logs for any hits with the token string. Filtering by request IDs RelayLog provided too. ETA ~20m.

carla_security: dave, when rotating ensure RBAC: only the two ops service principals and the auth service can create global webhook tokens going forward. We'll need a PR to enforce that.

dave_infra: Rotation steps (example):
```
# create new secret wrapped by KMS
aws secretsmanager create-secret --name integrations/webhook/global --secret-string '{"token":"<new-token>"}' --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:alias/redwood-cmk
# revoke old token in auth service
curl -s -X POST https://auth.internal/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-admin>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"token":"<old-token>"}'
```
I'll push to 5% canary then expand.

erin_pm: Legal/comms on standby. Drafting a short customer statement that Legal can review if needed: "A third-party vendor experienced an S3 restore misconfiguration that briefly exposed an internal credential. We rotated the credential and are investigating; no customer data exposure identified so far."

relaylog-status-bot: RelayLog update: restored objects made public inadvertently; ACLs fixed and objects removed 2026-05-02T04:14:12Z. Attestation PDF and ID export uploaded to their portal. https://relaylog.status/attest/REL-554

ben_sre: Found 2 deliveries using the token during the window from IPs outside our typical ranges. Both appear to be webhook retries to customer endpoints (POST /deliveries/*). No requests to admin or token-issuing endpoints so far. Collating full traces and other indicators.

carla_security: Ben please confirm no calls to `/auth/token` or admin routes. If clean, containment is limited to rotation + vendor controls. Keep P1 until final audit.

dave_infra: Rotation complete; new secret in Secrets Manager with KMS wrapping, old token revoked. Canary at 25% then to 100% after smoke checks passed. Documented steps in the incident ticket.

alice_vendor_ops: RelayLog emailed a signed attestation and offered to add a post-restore ACL test to their runbook; theyare also open to a short SLA for automated purges if tokens are detected.

carla_security: Post-rotation action items: 1) Ben to post an audit timeline + queries in 3h. 2) Dave to raise a PR restricting global token creation to two service principals. 3) Add vendor requirement: auto-notify + purge SLA and restore ACL checks. 4) Add detection rule: flag credential-like patterns in incoming webhook payloads and vendor logs.

erin_pm: I'll continue preparing the communications draft; Legal to sign off before any external notification. Suggested external line: "We were notified by a vendor that a misconfiguration briefly exposed an internal credential. We rotated the credential and found no evidence of misuse."

ben_sre: Query used (CloudWatch/CloudTrail style):
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress
| filter requestParameters like /integrations-webhook-global/ or @message like /Bearer\s[A-Za-z0-9\-\._~\+\/]+=*/
| sort @timestamp desc
```
Attaching traces to ticket.

carla_security: Schedule a 60m postmortem tomorrow; invite RelayLog engineering to present root cause and attest remediation. Postmortem actions must include vendor contract updates, runbook changes, and a control to prevent global webhook tokens from being persisted in third-party logs (auto-redact or token-format detection).

alice_vendor_ops: Incident ticket created INC-2026-410. I'll keep updates in #private-sec and the ticket. Thanks for the quick coordination.

carla_security: Closing this Slack thread; continue updates in the incident ticket. Nice work everyone :white_check_mark:
